practiceReport.beatComment: Green has strung together six consecutive full practices since being designated to return from injured reserve Nov. 11. He's not quite ready to be activated from IR, so his next chance to play is Week 12 against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 29. practiceReport.name: Bhayshul Tuten
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (76%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union previously reported that Jaguars head coach Liam Coen noted Monday that the re-check stemming from the aggravation of the ankle injury Tuten suffered in Week 11 suggested that the issue "wasn't too bad." That said, with the running back in line to log a Wednesday 'DNP," his status needs to be tracked leading up to Sunday's game against the Titans. If Tuten is limited or out this weekend, Chris Rodriguez would be next in line to see added touches, with LeQuint Allen and Ameer Abdullah also on hand.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Caleb Ransaw
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 7 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Ransaw suffered a knee injury during Sunday's game at Cincinnati, and now he'll have to sit out at least the next four games as he recovers. In parallel transactions, Jacksonville waived cornerback Christian Braswell (knee) with an injury designation and signed cornerbacks Jaylon Jones and Alijah Huzzie.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Zach Durfee
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The 2026 seventh-rounder will need to miss the first four weeks of the regular season at least before he is eligible to return to the active roster. Durfee is set to be a reserve piece of the Jaguars' defensive line throughout the 2026 season, and once he is healthy there should be a path to reserve snaps.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Anton Harrison
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The Jaguars were hoping that Harrison was undergoing just an arthroscopic procedure, but the surgeons found more damage than originally thought. As such, the 2023 first-rounder will miss the rest of the season, and how he progresses in his recovery over the coming months will determine whether he will be available for the start of the 2027 campaign. Walker Little figures to start at left tackle in Harrison's absence.

irAndReserveTracker.name: DaVon Hamilton
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Hamilton suffered a ruptured quad during Sunday's game versus the Colts, and now he'll spend the rest of the season on IR. His departure from Jacksonville's defensive line figures to open up more opportunities for 2024 second-rounder Ruke Orhorhoro as the campaign continues.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Devon Marshall
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The cornerback was waived with an injury designation last weekend before reverting to IR on Monday. Marshall can now play in 2026 if he's healthy enough and can find another opportunity.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Eric Murray
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: It was already known Murray suffered a season-ending elbow injury during the first quarter of Sunday's game versus the Colts, so the move comes as no big surprise. In his absence, 2025 sixth-rounder Rayuan Lane could step into a starting role at safety for the rest of the year.
